# Apache ECharts for the budget comparison beta

- Version: 6.1.0, pinned.
- Source: official `echarts` npm package, https://www.npmjs.com/package/echarts/v/6.1.0.
- File: the unmodified `dist/echarts.min.js` distribution.
- SHA-256: `b66b25aeb4df84e33199dc21694014d336d222cbd9deb0e5a7c14bd6aa0d0fd0`.

The app loads this local file only when the beta is opened. No CDN or internet
connection is required on the user's workstation. Existing Chart.js views keep
their current renderer.
